format.label: AI interview practice
format.sub: Timed, one question at a time: a self-introduction, story questions, a situational question and a structured-thinking question. 20–30 minutes.
format.timing: {prep} seconds to think, then up to {answer} seconds to answer.

report.title: AI interview practice: your results
report.format: This practice follows the AI interview format many employers use. The results describe this practice only and say nothing about the result of a real interview.
report.noAnswers: There are no answers to check yet. Answer a few questions to see these results.

areas.title: Three areas
areas.communicationHint: Clear, fluent answers with few filler words.
areas.logicHint: Conclusion first, then grouped points, then a short summary.
areas.behaviourHint: Real examples with the situation, task, action and result.

basis.ai_review: Source: AI review of this practice
basis.text_checks: Source: quick text checks on your answers
basis.mixed: Source: review of this practice (part of the AI review did not finish)

star.title: STAR check on story answers
star.explain: STAR stands for Situation, Task, Action, Result. A strong story has all four.
star.summary: {complete} of {total, plural, one {# story answer} other {# story answers}} had all four parts.
star.none: No story questions were answered in this practice.
star.question: Question: {question}
star.questionSource: The questions were asked by the AI interviewer. The four checks are keyword checks on your own answers.

tip.situation: Start with when and where it happened.
tip.task: Say what you were asked to do or what you aimed for.
tip.action: Say what you did yourself, step by step.
tip.result: End with what changed, with a number if you have one.

fillers.title: Filler words
fillers.total: {count, plural, =0 {No filler words found.} one {# filler word} other {# filler words}}
fillers.note: Counted from the transcript. Speech-to-text can miss or add words.

how.areasAi: Communication and logic come from the AI review of this practice. Story answers come from the STAR check. None of these predict a real interview.
how.areasText: Communication and logic come from quick text checks on your answers, not from an AI review. Story answers come from the STAR check. None of these predict a real interview.
how.star: A STAR part counts when the answer uses a plain cue for it, such as 当时 (situation), 目标 or 负责 (task), 我首先 (action), or 结果 or a number (result).
how.fillers: Filler words: 嗯 and 呃 always; 啊 and 额 only on their own; 那个, 就是 and 然后 only before a pause or when repeated; and phrases such as 怎么说呢 and 对吧. In English: um, uh, "you know", "I mean" and similar.
